newGroup.title: Prototype demonstration instructions
newGroup.passage: Thank you for helping with tomorrow's product demonstration. Each table will have one prototype, one charging cable, and one feedback form. Connect each unit to its charger tonight and check that demonstration mode is on. Visitors may try the touch controls, but the settings menu should remain locked because some functions are still under development. If a unit freezes, use the backup unit at the reception table and record the event. We want detailed feedback rather than estimates of when the product will ship.
newGroup.passageZh: 感謝各位協助明天的產品展示。每張桌子會有一台樣機、一條充電線和一份回饋表。請今晚把每台機器接上充電器，並確認展示模式已開啟。訪客可試用觸控操作，但設定選單應保持鎖定，因為部分功能仍在開發。如果機器當機，請使用接待桌上的備用機，並記錄事件。我們希望收集詳細回饋，而不是估計產品何時出貨。

newQuestions.prompt: What should staff do if a unit freezes?

options.text: Promise a shipping date to the visitor.
options.whyZh: 講者反而不希望估算出貨時間。
有備用機方案，沒有全面取消。

options.text: Use a spare and record what happened.
options.zh: 使用備用機並記錄事件。
options.whyZh: 指示包含換備用機及記錄事件兩步。

options.text: Ask the visitor to repair the hardware.

newGroup.title: Inventory counting notice
newGroup.passage: The warehouse will conduct its quarterly inventory count on Friday afternoon. Material requests needed for Friday's production must reach us by eleven in the morning. From noon to four, we will handle safety emergencies only. Team leaders should assign one person to confirm quantities with warehouse staff. For sealed boxes, use the quantity on the label unless the seal is damaged. Regular material pickup starts again at four thirty in the afternoon.
newGroup.passageZh: 倉庫將在星期五下午進行季度盤點。星期五生產所需的領料申請必須在上午十一點前送達。中午到下午四點，只處理緊急安全事件。各組主管應指派一人與倉庫人員核對數量。有封條的紙箱，若封條未破損，請依標籤上的數量盤點。下午四點半恢復正常領料。
